overview_description.description:
They revolutionize convenience for brands, retailers, and consumers alike. With their cutting-edge platform, they seamlessly connect FMCG brands to over 8000 retail outlets across the UAE, providing unparalleled access and distribution opportunities.

Their journey began in the year 2017 with a single goal to simplify distribution and serve UAE in the best way possible. Since then, they have evolved manifolds.

product.name: Conektr Business App
product.description: An application that allows groceries, supermarkets, and restaurants to order supplies, schedule deliveries, and subscribe to products from a selection of over 5000 FMCG items, available on web, iOS, and Android.

product.name: B2B Commerce Digitization
product.description: A service that digitizes B2B commerce, helping retailers manage inventory, streamline procurement, and access a variety of FMCG products without warehousing or delivery costs.

product.name: Brand Distribution Network
product.description: A service that assists brands in expanding their reach and improving sales coverage by connecting them with retailers and enhancing their distribution network.
